text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Water meters will be installed at private wells in Bahrain to save water.
- A Dutch warship is in Bahrain as part of a Middle East tour.
- Hundreds of young Bahrainis will get new job and training opportunities when Asea Brown Boveri expands Bahrain operations.
- Investment in small and medium industries in Bahrain rise to 200 million dinars.
- Al-Ahli Commercial Bank ratifies a proposed 2.64 million dinar dividend to shareholders for 1996.
- Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa gets two messages from Philippines president.
